question: In which of the following cities is the head office of SEBI located?
solution:
The correct answer is __Mumbai__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The headquarter of SEBI is situated in Mumbai.
 
• The regional offices of SEBI are located in Ahmedabad, Kolkata, Chennai, and Delhi.
 
• The Securities and Exchange Board of India:
 
 
• It is a statutory body.
 
• It was established on April 12, 1992, in accordance with the provisions of the Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992.
 
• Its basic functions are to protect the interests of investors in securities and to promote and regulate the securities market.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

Power and functions of SEBI:

 
• SEBI is a quasi-legislative and quasi-judicial body that can draft regulations, conduct inquiries, pass rulings, and impose penalties.
 
• It functions to fulfill the requirements of three categories:
 
 
• Issuers – By providing a marketplace in which the issuers can increase their finance.
 
• Investors – By ensuring safety and supply of precise and accurate information.
 
• Intermediaries – By enabling a competitive professional market for intermediaries.
